scope: Idol (Speridlabs), single image to 3D Gaussian splat: what it is, the claims checked (~2 s, low VRAM, quality, consumer GPUs, native ComfyUI), weights and licences as information, the ComfyUI-Idol pack, the core-node graph Fuobe would build, hosted routes (none), comparison with Fuobe's 3D models, placements and a 9-package build plan. Read-only research: nothing installed, nothing run, no paid call.

verdict.asGoodAsClaimed: No. The architecture claims hold (it is TripoSplat retrained and runs on ComfyUI's stock TripoSplat nodes), but '~2 s' is not supported by any published number (fastest 3.4 s on a B300 via the compiled SDK; 14-46 s on consumer GPUs; ~22-26 s on an RTX 5090 in ComfyUI), 'low VRAM' means a 7.2 GB vendor peak (8 GB class, same as TripoSplat), and the quality lead over TripoSplat is vendor-only and small (+0.014 SSIM, +0.002 IoU, +0.038 DINOv2). Raw outputs carry a haze of near-transparent Gaussians.
verdict.worthAdding: Yes, cheaply: a second open splat model in Image to 3D -> Splat, built from a copy of Fuobe's existing core TripoSplat graph, 1.32 GB of new Apache-2.0 weights, no custom nodes required. Not a headline feature and not 'instant 3D'; choose the default between TripoSplat and Idol with a blind A/B (idol-3). No cloud route.

idol.name: Idol
idol.architecturePaper: TripoSplat, arXiv:2605.16355 (Yan, Cao, Wang, Liang, Guo; 2026-05-08)
idol.bibtex: @misc{canada2026idol}, 'Idol: Single Image to 3D Gaussian Splats' (project page only)
idol.input: one RGB picture of one object (render, generated image or photo); no multi-view
idol.preprocess: short side to 1024; BiRefNet unless real alpha; alpha eroded 1 px (3x3 min filter); square crop of margin x bbox; 1024x1024 on black (idol/preprocess.py L13-37)
idol.output: one 3DGS splat, default 262,144 Gaussians (32,768-1,048,576 documented; ComfyUI clamps, the SDK only floors to a multiple of 32), .ply 17 float32 per Gaussian, degree-0 SH, y-up; plus a predicted input camera

projectPageSizesMb.note: not .ply; guess a compressed web format such as .spz

method.conditioning: DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 tokens (1280, layer-normed) + FLUX.2 VAE latent tokens (128, 2x2-packed)
method.denoiser: rectified-flow DiT LatentSeqMMFlowModel, 24 blocks, width 1024, 16 heads, 370.6M params; 8192 tokens x 16 + 5-value camera token
method.sampler: Euler, 50 steps, linspace(1,0) shifted t' = 3t/(1+2t); CFG (1+w)cond - w*uncond, w 3.0, zero negative = ComfyUI cfg 4.0; shift 3 = ComfyUI TripoSplat's built-in shift
method.decoders: octree 50.8M (max level 8) + Gaussian 237.3M (32 Gaussians per anchor)

params.fullRequest: about 1.8B with BiRefNet 220.7M, DINOv3 840.6M, FLUX.2 VAE 84.1M

relationToTripoSplat.architecture: identical: 559 denoiser tensors and 388 decoder tensors with the same names, shapes, dtypes, offsets (HTTP range reads of the headers)
relationToTripoSplat.weights: different: denoiser matrices cosine 0.02-0.26 vs TripoSplat, norm gains 0.95, decoders 0.47-0.90 (first <=32 KB of sampled tensors); guess: initialised from TripoSplat and trained further
relationToTripoSplat.comfyui: loads through the TripoSplat classes (model_detection.py L832, sd.py L1093-1094); pos_pe recomputed (Sobol seed 123); TripoSplat first in ComfyUI v0.23.0; v0.43.1 TripoSplat code identical to 0.41.0
relationToTripoSplat.consequence: same per-step cost as TripoSplat in Fuobe's ComfyUI path

idol.haze: about half the Gaussians have opacity under 0.05 (pack README; also in the SDK's own .ply); core ComfyUI can threshold renders (RenderSplat opacity_threshold) and meshes (SplatToMesh min_opacity) but cannot prune a saved splat; IdolPruneSplat can
idol.space: speridlabs/idol (ZeroGPU A10G, optimize off, demo/model.py L12-14)

claims.claim: Generates in ~2 s (card and SDK README: 'can run in under 2 seconds')
claims.evidence: No settings given. Vendor GPU table at 50 steps / 262,144: B300 3.4, B200 3.6, H200 6.6, H100 6.7, RTX 5090 14.1, A100 16.3, L40S 16.6, RTX 4090 19.1, RTX 3080 46.2, L4 54.6 s. Project page headline 3.4 s. SDK optimize path (compile, batched CFG, cuDNN, TF32; ~1.7x) on by default. ComfyUI on RTX 5090 ~18 s sampling + 4-8 s decode (pack author).

claims.claim: Works with low VRAM (7.2 GB; 'under 8 GB')
claims.evidence: Vendor-measured, GPU not stated; 3.7-4.4 GB of weights; RTX 3080 10 GB in their table; ComfyUI decode estimate +0.23 GB at 262,144 (computed). 8 GB class like TripoSplat (Fuobe manifest vramGb 8).
RTX 5090 14.1 s, 4090 19.1 s, 3080 46.2 s (vendor, SDK); ~22-26 s on RTX 5090 in ComfyUI (pack author).

claims.claim: Better quality than TripoSplat, TRELLIS and LGM
claims.evidence: Vendor table only. Idol SSIM 0.726 / LPIPS 0.213 / IoU 0.862 / DINOv2 0.781 / CLIP 0.885 / sharpness 0.81 / PSNR 12.25; TripoSplat 0.712 / 0.225 / 0.860 / 0.743 / 0.868 / 1.03 / 11.76; TRELLIS (unversioned) 0.716 / 0.235 / 0.845 / 0.754 / 0.868 / 0.97 / 11.89; LGM best PSNR 12.46. No paper, no named test set, no TRELLIS.2 or Hunyuan3D.
ComfyUI clamps to 32,768-1,048,576; the SDK enforces no range. 262,144 matches the octree's point density; more is denser, not more detailed.

claims.claim: Idol is TripoSplat retrained, so it runs natively in ComfyUI
claims.evidence: Identical tensor tables; same ComfyUI classes; shift and pos_pe match; weights differ. Parity numbers (3e-6 / 1e-4-3e-3) are the pack author's, not rerun.

claims.claim: Faster than TripoSplat (6.8 s vs 9.9 s on H100)
claims.evidence: Vendor numbers; same network size, so the gap is the compiled SDK. In Fuobe both run the same ComfyUI code; Fuobe's TripoSplat graph uses 20 dpmpp_2m steps, Idol's reference 50 Euler.

packages.title: Idol 3D in Image to 3D -> Splat (open engine, core TripoSplat nodes, Best / Quick look, photo crop)
packages.brief:
GOAL. Add Speridlabs' Idol as a second open-engine model in Image to 3D -> Splat, named 'Idol 3D', running on Fuobe's existing core TripoSplat graph with Idol's two weight files and Idol's reference sampler settings. Read docs/research/idol-9.md §2 (in and out; §2.3 same architecture as TripoSplat; §2.4 the haze), §3 (the claims: never promise seconds), §4 (weights and licences), §5.4-5.5 (the graph), §7, §8 and §9 idol-1.

WEIGHTS. In scripts/comfy/library.spec.mjs KNOWN_MODELS, after the TripoSplat rows (L273-275), add two rows pinned to nynxz/Idol @ c718f2b1b95b353edd07d17e845719fc10880a44:
- 'idol_fp16.safetensors': { folder: 'diffusion_models', url: 'https://huggingface.co/nynxz/Idol/resolve/c718f2b1b95b353edd07d17e845719fc10880a44/diffusion_models/idol_fp16.safetensors' } (741,107,210 B, sha256 cf452146f78e23a0d34be8f9f79bcde642b9a40ef493046c8e9d5f79096f6dd0)
- 'idol_decoder_fp16.safetensors': { folder: 'vae', url: 'https://huggingface.co/nynxz/Idol/resolve/c718f2b1b95b353edd07d17e845719fc10880a44/vae/idol_decoder_fp16.safetensors' } (576,148,658 B, sha256 c511d99eb668ec4b06d883cb6e43770bc35e3864e16e7058e8d6211ba5c509aa)
with a comment: a third-party conversion (ComfyUI-Idol scripts/convert.py at 4d3a4f6) of speridlabs/idol @ 2731c229 (Apache-2.0): pos_pe dropped (ComfyUI recomputes it), cast to fp16, the two decoders merged under octree./gs.; spot-checked faithful on 10 tensor prefixes (§3, §4.1). dino_v3_vit_h (L273), flux2-vae (L230) and birefnet (L168) are already there and shared with TripoSplat: only 1.32 GB is new. Optional in the same package: move 'flux2-vae.safetensors' from Comfy-Org/flux2-dev to the renamed Comfy-Org/Flux-2-Dev (the old URL is a 307 redirect; same sha256 d64f3a68...), rebuild, and check that only URL strings change in workflows/comfyui/manifest.json.

GRAPH. New scripts/comfy/hand-built/image-to-splat-idol.json: a copy of hand-built/image-to-splat-triposplat.json with the same node ids and these changes (§5.5):
- 88:16 UNETLoader unet_name 'idol_fp16.safetensors' (weight_dtype default).
- 88:11 VAELoader vae_name 'idol_decoder_fp16.safetensors'.
- 88:6 KSampler steps 50, cfg 4.0, sampler_name 'euler', scheduler 'simple', denoise 1. Idol's CFG weight 3 in its (1+w)cond - w*uncond form is ComfyUI cfg 4; its rescale_t 3 is TripoSplat's built-in shift 3 (comfy/supported_models.py L1677-1679), so no ModelSamplingSD3 node.
- Photo crop branch (core nodes, my analysis): 88:101 ImageScale {image [88:2,0], upscale_method 'lanczos', width 720, height 720, crop 'disabled'}; 88:102 EmptyImage {width 1024, height 1024, batch_size 1, color 0}; 88:103 ImageCompositeMasked {destination [88:102,0], source [88:101,0], x 152, y 152, resize_source false}; 88:104 ComfySwitchNode {switch false, on_false [88:2,0], on_true [88:103,0]}; 88:24 TripoSplatConditioning image [88:104,0] (was [88:2,0]). TripoSplatPreprocessImage (88:2) is Idol's 'synthetic' 1.2 crop; scaled to 720 and centred on black 1024 the object spans 600 px, Idol's 'real' 1.7 crop gives 602 px. ComfySwitchNode inputs are lazy (comfy_extras/nodes_logic.py L98-111), so the untaken branch does not run.
- 75 RenderSplat opacity_threshold 0.05 (was 0): the orbit video drops the near-transparent haze (§2.4). The saved file still has it; idol-2 prunes it.
- 88:96 (a ComfySwitchNode whose two inputs are the same UNETLoader) may stay as it is.
- Everything else as in the TripoSplat file: 99 LoadImage, the cut-out switch 88:35 (BiRefNet 88:85:81/82 or the PNG's own alpha via 88:95), 88:7 CLIPVisionLoader dino_v3_vit_h, 88:8 VAELoader flux2-vae, 88:55 VAEDecodeTripoSplat, 92 SplatToFile3D (spz), 51 SaveGLB 'fuobe/splat', 79 CreateCameraInfo orbit 35/30/2.5, 41 CreateVideo 25 fps h264, 42 SaveVideo 'fuobe/splat-orbit'.

SPEC ENTRY. packages.title: Splat A/B in the evaluation harness: Idol Best / Quick against TripoSplat, to choose Splat mode's default
packages.brief:
GOAL. Decide with numbers, not the vendor's table, which open splat model is Splat mode's default (TripoSplat today or Idol 3D), what Idol's Quick preset should be, and whether the photo crop helps photos. Read idol-9.md §3 (the vendor-only quality claim), §7.2 and §9 idol-3, and scripts/eval/README.md (the promote rule: a person changes a default in a reviewed commit). Builds on idol-1 (and idol-2 if merged).

SUITE. scripts/eval/cases/splat.json (validated by case.schema.json): suite 'splat', title 'Splat · one object from one picture', kind 'video' (the orbit video is the main output: scripts/eval/lib/review.mjs L19 and covers.mjs L66 pick the first image or video that is not a mask, so the turntable is scored and shown; the .spz is kept as a file), targets open { models: ['oss-idol', 'oss-triposplat'] } and demo. Variants:
- 'idol-best': oss-idol, extra { steps 50, sampler 'euler', cfg 4, numGaussians 262144 }
- 'idol-quick': oss-idol, extra { steps 20, sampler 'dpmpp_2m', cfg 4, numGaussians 65536 }
- 'triposplat-today': oss-triposplat with its manifest defaults (20 dpmpp_2m, cfg 3)
- 'triposplat-50': oss-triposplat at 50 euler, cfg 4 (separates the weights from the settings; needs 'sampler' bound in TripoSplat's entry too, or skip this variant)
- 'idol-photo-crop' on the photo cases: idol-best with photoCrop true (and cropMode 'real' when idol-2 is merged)
Cases (inputs under local/splat/, never committed; demoInputs from fixtures/): 8-12 single objects: generated product renders (bottle, sneaker, headphones), product photos (photo crop on), a figurine, a stylised character, a realistic person, thin parts (chair, plant), glass or chrome. references = the input picture.
Metrics: 'style' with --style-model dinov2 (orbit frames against the input picture; DINOv2 is Apache-2.0), 'temporal' (orbit smoothness), 'aesthetic'; the harness's timing and memory telemetry; the blind A/B review page (pnpm eval:review) for the turntables. Optional: a 'splat' metric that reads the .ply / .spz and reports the share of Gaussians under opacity 0.05 (to answer whether TripoSplat has Idol's haze); only if cheap.

OUTPUT. A short results section appended to idol-9.md (§3 and §7.2 updated with measured numbers, GPU named) and a recommendation; the default change itself (MODELS_3D.splat.open order in src/lib/av/model3d.ts L57, IDOL_PRESETS) goes in a separate reviewed commit by a person.

TESTS. pnpm eval:validate (schema), a demo dry run (pnpm eval:run --suite splat --engine demo --dry-run) and a demo run; any new metric gets pytest fixtures like the others (scripts/eval/metrics).

MUST NOT BREAK. Other suites, the case schema's existing kinds (image, video, audio), the promote rule.

VERIFY HERE. Schema and demo runs only. GPU runs need a machine with an 8-16 GB GPU and the weights; record the GPU, driver and ComfyUI version with the numbers.

CLOUD RULE. No Idol on the cloud. A 'triposplat-cloud' reference variant on fal tripo3d/triposplat is allowed (it is the existing cloud model, priced under the harness's spend cap), clearly labelled TripoSplat.

GOAL. Side and back views of an object from one picture, consistent with each other, for the places that need several angles. Read idol-9.md §5.1 (IdolCamera), §8 and §9 idol-8. Needs idol-2's pack (IdolCamera) and idol-1.

GRAPH. scripts/comfy/hand-built/image-to-views-idol.json (packs ['ComfyUI-Idol']): the clean Idol graph -> IdolCamera {samples [88:6,0]} -> RenderSplat {splat (pruned), camera_info from IdolCamera, frames 4, width / height 1024, opacity_threshold 0.05, background white or the studio's grey} -> SaveImage x1 batch of four (RenderSplat with frames > 1 orbits a full turn from camera_info, 360/n degrees apart: comfy_extras/nodes_gaussian_splat.py L1004-1006; a negative frames value turns the other way). Outputs: four images with meta.index 0-3 (front = the input view). Match the orbit direction to Fuobe's side names (front, left, back, right; SIDES_HINT in src/lib/av/model3d.ts L80-88: 'facing its front, walk round to your right for its left side'): pick the sign of frames so index 1 is the object's left; test it with an asymmetric object.

PLACES.
- Image to 3D -> From several images: with only the front filled, a button 'Make the other sides from the front (Idol 3D)' runs the graph and fills the left, back and right slots for oss-trellis2-multi (VIEW_SIDES order).
- Elements (character and product references): 'Add side and back views'.
Both open engine only; say the views are renders of a 3D guess and may be soft.

EVAL FIRST. Faces and characters are the risky case (20 of Idol's 94 demo presets are figurines; realistic people are untested). Add cases to idol-3's suite and look at the sheets before shipping.

TESTS. Spec entry with packs, bindings, the side mapping (index -> side), the multi-view slot filling, the chain into oss-trellis2-multi.

MUST NOT BREAK. From several images when the user brings real photos; Elements' existing uploads.

VERIFY HERE. Isolated worker /prompt validation; no GPU runs.

CLOUD RULE. None (Idol is not hosted).

packages.title: Idol props in Cinema Studio's 3D scene
packages.brief:
GOAL. Put an object made from a picture into Cinema Studio's 3D scene as a prop, frame it with the virtual camera and film the path. Read idol-9.md §7.1 and §9 idol-9. Needs idol-1 and idol-4's splat renderer.

WHERE. src/components/cinema/scene-viewer.tsx (the 'object' layout labelled '3D model' at L633), scene-engine.ts, scene-path.tsx, scene-actions.tsx. An 'Add a prop' action: pick a picture or an existing Idol 3D / TripoSplat result from the Library; run oss-idol (open engine) if it is a picture; load the splat into the scene with idol-4's renderer (as a three.js object in the same scene graph, sorted with the MoGe mesh); move, scale and turn handles; Idol's predicted camera (IdolCamera, idol-2) can set the first orientation. The prop must appear in the browser render that the open Fly path feeds to Uni3C (scene-engine.ts recordPath), so filming includes it.

TESTS. Scene state round trip with a prop; transforms; the recorded path includes the prop (a pixel test on a frame); e2e at 1440 and 390 px.

MUST NOT BREAK. The MoGe scene, the camera path, Film this path (N7-5), recompose.

VERIFY HERE. Demo mode with a sample splat.

CLOUD RULE. None for Idol (not hosted); a cloud TripoSplat .ply from the Library can be placed too, since it is an existing model's file.

risks: The '~2 s' expectation will not hold: fastest published 3.4 s on a B300 via the compiled SDK; consumer cards 14-46 s; ~22-26 s on an RTX 5090 in ComfyUI. Label presets by steps and Gaussians.
Same network cost as TripoSplat in ComfyUI; Idol's edge is vendor-reported quality only. A/B before making it the default.
Name clash with the 'Idol' K-pop video app (apps.ts L1486): call the model 'Idol 3D'.
Core-only graph leaves the haze in downloads (no core prune node); idol-2 or idol-4's viewer cut-off fixes what users see.
Brand-new single-maintainer, AI-assisted pack (3 commits in 24 minutes, no tags, no Registry); idol-sdk has 1 commit. Pin 4d3a4f6.
Third-party converted weights (nynxz/Idol) checked on 10 tensor prefixes only. Pin c718f2b1 and the two sha256, or convert from speridlabs/idol @ 2731c229.
Pack README states the wrong ComfyUI minimum (0.22; really 0.23.0).
Thin provenance: no paper, undisclosed training data, self-run benchmark; weights look started from TripoSplat (MIT) without the MIT notice. Show TripoSplat attribution.
DINOv3 terms carry over ('Built with DINOv3', trade-control limits).
The SDK route needs gated repos (DINOv3 manual approval; FLUX.2-dev repo terms); use the ComfyUI route.
flux2-vae URL works only through HF's rename redirect.
Scope: one object, background removed; not a scene model. The core photo crop is unverified analysis.
No splat viewer until idol-4; 'look around' is an orbit video meanwhile.
VRAM: 7.2 GB vendor peak rules out 6 GB GPUs; 8 GB borderline and unmeasured in ComfyUI.
CPU and Apple: possible in fp32 through ComfyUI but likely tens of minutes per object (guess).
ComfyUI API drift: the pack depends on comfy_api.latest types and the TripoSplat code (unchanged 0.41.0 -> 0.43.1); the core-only graph is the safer base.
unknowns: Real VRAM peak and run time in ComfyUI on 8-12 GB GPUs; effect of ComfyUI offloading; the GPU of the 7.2 GB measurement.
CPU and Apple MPS run time through ComfyUI.
Training data, and how Idol's weights relate to TripoSplat's (guess from 10 tensor prefixes).
Independent quality vs TripoSplat, TRELLIS.2 and Hunyuan3D 2.1 (photos, people, characters, thin parts, glass); the 'TRELLIS' version in the vendor table.
Whether TripoSplat's splats have the same haze.
Quality of the Quick preset (20 dpmpp_2m, 65,536).
Whether the core photo crop matches IdolPreprocessImage 'real' closely enough.
Full-file fidelity of nynxz/Idol; ComfyUI-vs-SDK parity not rerun.
Whether the fp32 denoiser loads straight into UNETLoader, and whether TorchCompileModel works (pack claims).
The format of the project page's 0.4 / 3.2 / 12.2 MB sizes.
Quality of SplatToMesh meshes and RenderSplat side views of Idol splats.
Whether Speridlabs, fal or Replicate will host Idol; plans beyond v0.1.
Which three.js splat renderer and version Fuobe should adopt.
